description: This is a PHP source file that generates a web page for managing LAN Ethernet settings on a network gateway. It includes server-side logic for retrieving device information, configuring Ethernet ports, and generating the corresponding HTML and JavaScript for user interaction.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether the Ethernet port 4 is enabled for XHSE (XFINITY Home Security) based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps Ethernet port status to user-friendly status strings based on device operational modes and partner configurations.

methods.name: onsavePort4
methods.description: Handles the AJAX POST request to save the Ethernet port 2 (XHSE) enable status.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for the page UI elements.
